one_global_brief_before_parts: main identity and secondary information intent
each_part_brief: free composition intent for this part
assembly_checks: Does the whole vehicle have a clear hierarchy rather than every part competing?
Do movement boundaries and physical plate changes make sense?
Are complete marks readable and not clipped by masks or colour transitions?
Are material and mechanical details preserved?
execution: A single executor may work all parts; this contract does not request or automatically start agents.
ownership_and_granularity: Confirm actual surface/UV boundaries before allocating production work.
Use one decomposition level for a physical face: H04 is the broad side task; H07 can split that task into individual panels, not an overlapping second paint pass.
Assign a physical editing region to one writer at a time; shared global parameters and the active Composa document have one owner.
Part design briefs may be proposed independently, then assembled and checked for whole-vehicle hierarchy.
